description: The government is reworking the pipes to transport water to houses in the area. The water can be transported through wide pipes or narrow pipes. Wide pipes can transport 25 units of water per minute and narrow pipes can transport 15 units of water per minute. Due to logistics, the number of wide pipes can be at most a third the number of narrow pipes. If there needs to be at least 900 units of water transported every minute, and at least 5 wide pipes must be used, minimize the total number of pipes required.

WidePipeCapacity.definition: Water transport capacity of a wide pipe (units per minute)

NarrowPipeCapacity.definition: Water transport capacity of a narrow pipe (units per minute)

MaxWideToNarrowRatio.definition: Maximum ratio of wide pipes to narrow pipes

MinTransportRequired.definition: Minimum required water transported per minute

MinWidePipes.definition: Minimum number of wide pipes required

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of pipes (wide and narrow) required to transport the water"

constraints.description: 25 * (number of wide pipes) + 15 * (number of narrow pipes) >= 900
(number of wide pipes) <= MaxWideToNarrowRatio * (number of narrow pipes)
(number of wide pipes) and (number of narrow pipes) must be integers
